snippet.title: Batman: Caped Crusader - Chronicles: Official Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Check out the Official Trailer for the Batman: Caped Crusader - Chronicles videogame. 

Watch the Series, Play the Game

Gotham's darkest crimes won't solve themselves. Go solo or gather your crew and dive into the noir-drenched 1940s Gotham City of the Batman: Caped Crusader animated series, where every alley hides a secret, and every case leads deeper into the shadowy depths of Gotham’s criminal minds.

In this cooperative party game for 1 to 4 players, you'll join forces with Renee Montoya as part of Batman’s inner circle, uncovering evidence, chasing leads, and confronting iconic villains across 11 gripping episodes. Test your detective skills to surface clues in 11 detective minigames.  Investigate, interrogate, deduce and decode your way through the crime webs woven by 10 of Gotham’s most devious criminals including Scarecrow, Babyface, Tweedledee and Tweedledum, Dollmaker, Lynx, Music Meister and of course, the Joker. 

Batman and the citizens of Gotham are counting on you!

Crack the cases, Save the City.

Play the Game, Watch the Series!
